_comment: Lifecycle hooks for GreenScout. Mirrors the pre-commit quality gates from CLAUDE.md §5. Hooks should be merged into settings.json's top-level `hooks` key during Claude Code setup if your CC version requires that (see COPY-INSTRUCTIONS.md).

PostToolUse._comment: After any file edit/write, format & lint the file path the agent just touched. Best-effort: hooks should never block legitimate work, so individual command failures only warn.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -Eq '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|md)$'; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [ -n "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -Eq '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [ -n "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -Eq '\.py$'; then ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; ruff format "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

PreCommit._comment: Run before any git commit the agent initiates. Failure here BLOCKS the commit — the agent must fix or pause, never bypass.

PrePush._comment: Belt-and-braces before pushing a branch. Same as PreCommit so a forced bypass at commit time still gets caught here.

hooks.command: if git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | grep -qx main; then echo 'BLOCK: refusing to push main'; exit 1; fi
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check

SessionStart._comment: Reminder: read the contract before acting.

hooks.command: echo '[Claude Code] Read SPEC.md, CLAUDE.md, TASKS.md before acting. Auto-mode: balanced (2h / 500k tokens). Forbidden actions in CLAUDE.md §8.'
